title: 교통류 관측 정보의 해상도가 최적화 성능에 미치는 영향과 적응적 정보 집계에 관한 연구

candidates.name: H01 — 관측 오차와 목적함수 오차의 불일치
candidates.note: T174 standard conditional Jensen gap explains objective-aligned flux improvement; exact synthetic support, independent rational audit; novel transport-specific application unconfirmed.

candidates.name: H04 — 총량 관측으로 공통 편향 제거
candidates.note: B3 ideal anchor, substantial synthetic gains; cost/identifiability unresolved

candidates.name: H02 — 관측 표현의 후회 하한과 학습 초과 후회
candidates.note: T168/169 standard finite decision principle; distinguish new domain-specific discovery

candidates.name: H03 — 미래 조건만 바뀌는 관측 충돌
candidates.note: I167B/I168A matched prefix; no measured predictor

candidates.name: H06 — 공간 집계와 국소/전체 비용 충돌
candidates.note: H06B native audit and locality proof support finite result; direct prior-art overlap in block probabilities and spatial correlations; long words essentially full rotation class, no verified compression advantage or novelty.

candidates.name: H09 — 사건시각 및 관측 시간 해상도
candidates.note: P35 forward-only and interval uncertainty documented in archive, external independent verification incomplete.

candidates.name: H05 — 시간 해상도와 정확한 계산 압축
H08 — 원인별 관측과 다목적 결정 충분성
candidates.note: Historical T1/common-optimizer set-system idea, PHYS counterexamples; theory known, specific multiobjective representation study not yet done.

candidates.name: H07 — 실제 관측 정보의 가치 검증
candidates.note: No measurement; teacher-approved aggregate model only

candidates.name: H10 — 정보 취득·전환 비용과 집단 반응
candidates.note: 10/27 information-cost/behavior idea; informational Braess and related work preexist, no current specific validated claim.

anchor: 0 absent; .25 weak/blocked; .5 partial/indirect; .75 strong but limited; 1 direct/complete for the specific axis. These are ordinal judgment anchors, not calibrated probabilities. Separate hard gates from scores. New next-action score not directly comparable to Harvest02.

tasks.name: EX01C — 학생 독립 재현
tasks.reason: Essential evidence; cannot count AI work as student execution; provide independently checkable task.

tasks.name: H09A — 기존 자료의 시간 불확실성 독립 감사
tasks.reason: High discrimination and potential external evidence; first verify permitted aggregate input, provenance and non-holdout availability.

tasks.name: H04A — 불완전한 총량 관측과 목표별 보정
tasks.reason: Directly tests whether ideal anchor benefit survives uncertain totals; existing finite data, distinct target losses; still synthetic.

tasks.name: H08A — 다목적 정보 동치류와 공통 최적해
tasks.reason: Restores initial 10/27 common-action intersection and 11/24 cause distinction; separate cost/label sufficiency and exact common-optimizer failure, not another threshold lookup; theory established.

tasks.name: H07 — 교사 승인 탁상 모형 실험
tasks.reason: High potential external evidence; hardware/approval/independent truth missing; not executable by assistant.

tasks.name: I169A — 단순 통계 추정 기준선
tasks.reason: Repeated lookup failures motivate a distinct estimator; fresh synthetic validation but not field evidence.

tasks.name: H06C — 공간 조합의 장기 압축
tasks.reason: High-k near-full rotation quotient and established locality reduce marginal value; only revisit with real encoding/forecast gain hypothesis.

tasks.name: H01B — 비선형 분기점과 손실 불일치
tasks.reason: T174 already explains Jensen mechanism; additional case studies less discriminating unless a new objective is introduced.

tasks.name: H10A — 추상적 정보 취득 비용과 집단 선택
tasks.reason: Original cross-domain question, but less directly tied to present physical reconstruction and strong prior art.

tasks.name: AGG04D — 계산 모드 선택
tasks.reason: Supports reproducibility and efficiency rather than central information claim.

tasks.name: 기존 평가자료에 맞춘 임계값 조정
tasks.reason: Repeated failures and test leakage; excluded rather than rescued by weighted score.

selection: H04A and H08A co-priority; execute both distinct low-cost lines before narrowing. No claim rank difference is robust; H09A conditional and student/teacher tasks separate from AI-ready list. Reconsider H06C only with a new discriminating question.
priorArt: Fuks 2013 local structure maps and 1999 CA traffic exact results, Geroliminis/Sun adjacent density correlation; abstracts/introduction only, novelty not established.
notes: Previous candidate weights retained for comparison; execution score changed to penalize repetitive experiments and prioritize discrimination and independent evidence. Sensitivity varies one weight +/-25%, not uncertainty intervals.
